responsibility: Provides general-purpose inference diagnostic note helpers that attach cause-specific labels, notes, and targeted suggestions for type mismatches—especially around patterns, `match`/`if` arm incompatibilities, `let...else`, and binding-introduced lifetime requirements—and exposes block-span utilities used to point those diagnostics at the relevant expression or statement.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `infer/error_reporting/note.rs`, this `note.rs` handles general type-mismatch note attachment from `ObligationCauseCode` across patterns, `match`/`if` arms, and `let...else`, and provides block-span helpers used to point at relevant expressions; it only adds contextual labels/notes or suggestions rather than constructing the dedicated region-failure diagnostics.
